ops.body: Standalone review fixes (2026-09-23): the Datadog Codex adapter now sets DDVIZ_HOST=codex, and the enabled real forward.sh path accepts that signal while preserving the Claude entrypoint gate. The ddviz daemon now tracks Codex session IDs: ending one of two sessions keeps it alive, ending the final session terminates when no Claude parent PID remains, and Claude PID liveness still prevents premature termination in mixed-host use. WLM research.md now resolves its shared procedure through ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/research/SKILL.md; an unrelated-project-cwd test proves the resolved file exists. Verification passed: 4 Datadog native tests including a real shell path with an isolated fake Swift socket daemon and an extracted real Swift lifecycle harness, swiftc -typecheck, bash -n, WLM targeted pytest and ruff, slop-cop on changed Markdown, and git diff --check. Limits: no graphical AppKit daemon or authenticated Datadog call was launched. The fleet package rejection for WLM draft at ${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}} is host-conditional rather than a Codex resource error, so the shared Claude fallback was preserved.
